scope: R2 L2 canonical acceptance for R3 graph construction
principle: Acceptance uses independent mandatory gates. No summed score and no compensation across failed gates.

source_normalization.evidence_rule: PASS with >=1 direct Tier-A source OR >=2 independent direct Tier-B-or-better sources. A single generic review is insufficient.

mandatory_gates.evidence_sufficiency: Direct source path meets normalized evidence rule.
mandatory_gates.measurement_validity: Construct-specific measurement route exists and remains subject to the core measurement-validity map.
mandatory_gates.non_redundancy: Node survived R2 closure as an active canonical construct with no unresolved merge/move conflict.
mandatory_gates.contradiction_boundary: Explicit boundary conditions exist and core-level disconfirmation coverage is present; node-specific contradictions are preserved where available.
mandatory_gates.transport_context: BOUNDED_PASS only; culture/population/platform uncertainty is inherited from the R1 context map and never licenses universal generalization.
mandatory_gates.provenance: Claim IDs and source registries are preserved and previously registry-validated.

acceptance_rule: All mandatory gates must pass; transport is intentionally BOUNDED_PASS. Any failed gate retains provisional status with an explicit gap.
semantic_note: accepted = canonical enough for next-stage graph construction, not universally true or context-free.
